It is incredibly difficult to provide emotional support to a partner when you are also feeling depleted and overwhelmed by the same pressures. When you are facing a pay cut, job insecurity, and the lingering stress of a family health scare, your own "emotional cup" can feel empty, making it hard to find the energy to pour into someone else.

One way to approach this is to be honest with Margaret about your own capacity. You might consider sharing with her that you want to be there for her, but that you are currently struggling to process your own feelings of overwhelm. Sometimes, acknowledging your own limitations can actually bring you closer together because it moves the dynamic from "I have to fix this for you" to "We are facing this together."
